page.overview:
Who is Bunky?

Bunky is a minor character in the 1981 film For Your Eyes Only. He was played by Paul Brooke.

Bunky is Countess Lisl von Schlaf's card-playing friend whom James Bond meets at the chemin de fer table at Milos Columbo's club in Corfu. He lost all his money against Bond.
